params.linkText: The Fame Game: Welcome to Hollywood

children: with a new story centered around identity, ambition, romance, and the high-stakes social world of Los Angeles. Filmed on location throughout Los Angeles by a professional production team with Hollywood film and television experience, the game incorporates feature-film-inspired direction, cinematography, lighting, costume, makeup, and production design to bring its setting to life.

The new installment follows He Shuhan, an ordinary international student who finds himself drawn into Los Angeles’ high society after assuming the identity of a wealthy heir. To maintain the deception, players must navigate five dangerous relationships and make hundreds of choices that shape those relationships, the story’s progression, and potential outcomes. Depending on the decisions made, players may preserve the illusion, lose everything, or uncover relationships that challenge the identity they have created.
Interactive Films expanded audience participation in the development of
The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker

through a global casting initiative that drew in more than 200,000 votes that helped shape the game's cast. The live-action production stars Zhong Chenyao as Ayaka alongside four additional actresses, whose performances bring the game's central relationships and branching narrative to life.

series reflects continued interest in interactive entertainment built around character-driven storytelling and player agency. Relationship-focused games have increasingly moved beyond traditional dating-simulation formats, incorporating cinematic presentation, branching narratives, and community-driven experiences that allow players to engage with stories through their own decisions.
The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker

advances Interactive Films’ combination of accessible interactive fiction and live-action entertainment. The title is designed to encourage replayability as players explore different relationships, choices, and consequences across multiple possible outcomes.

For more information, please visit: https://snail.com/.

Interactive Films (IF), a film and media subsidiary of Snail, Inc., was founded with the goal of reaching new video audiences, engaging enthusiastic viewers, and telling stories across various formats. IF is also the catalyst behind SaltyTV, a specialized film application designed to produce and showcase compelling short-form vertical content. The SaltyTV app is available for download from the iOS App Store and the Google Play Store. For more information, please visit: https://interactive-films.com/.
